# Shrey Pant

Systems engineer working in Rust and Scala on query execution engines,
database internals, and concurrent runtimes. B.Tech Computer Science,
RGIPT (2025).

## Open source
- Apache DataFusion #21882 : pluggable SpillFile/TempFileFactory abstraction (merged, DataFusion 55.0.0)
- Apache DataFusion #22230 : SortMergeJoin async spill migration (merged, DataFusion 55.0.0)
- arrow-rs #9749 : StreamDecoder skip-validation support (merged)
- ParadeDB #4219 (merged), #4343 : late-materialization pipeline for selective joins/limits
- ParadeDB #4306 (merged) : dynamic filter pushdown for hash joins
- ParadeDB #4413 : joinscan memory-pool rework matching Postgres work_mem semantics
- Cats Effect #4388 : WSTP thread-leak fix; #4352, #4380 : runtime stability fixes (merged)
- vilcacora : Scala Native ML inference runtime, Typelevel org, GSoC 2025 origin, mentored by Arman Bilge
- HelixDB #659, #697 (merged) : Tokio core-affinity fix, Podman support
